title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2608.08802v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) makes Multimodal Large Language Models more accurate, but the gains are brittle: simply paraphrasing a question or changing the prompt template can degrade them, which challenges reliable deployment in high-stakes scenarios like medical VQA. We trace this to two issues of the standard RL objective. First, the binary verifier conflates format with content, so the reward signal cannot tell a wrong answer apart from a misformatted one. Second, the training distribution covers only a thin slice of the real-world prompts that the model might meet at deployment, so policies that perform well on the training distribution can behave differently under unseen prompts during test. translated_title: 提升多模态RLVR的泛化鲁棒性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.08802v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）使多模态大语言模型更加准确，但这种增益是脆弱的：仅仅改写问题或更改提示模板就可能降低性能，这在医疗视觉问答等高风险场景中挑战了可靠部署。我们将此追溯到标准RL目标的两个问题。首先，二元验证器混淆了格式与内容，因此奖励信号无法区分错误答案与格式错误。其次，训练分布仅覆盖了模型在部署时可能遇到的真实世界提示的薄薄一层，因此在训练分布上表现良好的策略在测试时面对未见过的提示可能表现不同。这两种失败都要求一种鲁棒的后训练方法，帮助策略覆盖更广泛的语义等价提示分布，我们确定了两个有助于实现此目标的措施：分离格式与内容奖励，以及引入多样化的提示增强。
tldr: 本文指出多模态RLVR性能脆弱源于二元验证器混淆格式与内容及训练分布覆盖不足，提出通过分离格式与内容奖励和提示增强来提升泛化鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that brittleness in multimodal RLVR stems from binary verifiers conflating format with content and limited training distribution coverage, proposing to improve generalization robustness by separating format/content rewards and prompt augmentation.
